title.zh: 将南甘马粦省那牙市Liboton街更名为M.T. Villanueva大道，并为此作出规定的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Liboton Street in the City of Naga, Province of Camarines Sur to M.T. Villanueva Avenue
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Liboton Street in the City of Naga, Province of Camarines Sur to M.T. Villanueva Avenue
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Liboton Street tại Thành phố Naga, Tỉnh Camarines Sur thành M.T. Villanueva Avenue
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Liboton Street ในเมือง Naga, จังหวัด Camarines Sur เป็น M.T. Villanueva Avenue
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Liboton Street di Kota Naga, Provinsi Camarines Sur menjadi M.T. Villanueva Avenue
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Liboton Street di Bandaraya Naga, Wilayah Camarines Sur menjadi M.T. Villanueva Avenue

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9704_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Department of Libton Street in the CIty of Naga, Province of Camarines Sur shall hereinafter be known as M.T. Villanueva Avenue.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
